2. Erotic, Discriminatory, and types of inappropriate roleplay is not allowed
## Subtext - No sexual content/themes including erotic roleplay, erotic content, 18+ sexual content, or shock content is allowed on this server. - No discriminatory content/themes including roleplaying as stereotype of a group of people, using slurs, or other forms of discrimination is not allowed on this server. - Note: Biases against groups/organizations which exist in the setting is fine. If said biases are used as justification or as a way to allude to discrimination, however, we will know. - If roleplay reaches a point where it has become uncomfortable, immediately stop and contact an administrator or moderator.
## Examples Allowed: - Calling someone a dickhead, or a fuck. - Being affectionate in a mutually consensual way. - Being untrusting of a Syndicate Refugee on the merit they were a part of the Syndicate. - Not trusting a sentient version of a monster such as a carp, goliath, dragon, etc. - Insulting a character based on their individual characteristics or personal style choices.
Not Allowed: - Emoting sexual acts. - Memes that contain erotic or sexual content. - Emoting defecation or related acts - Creating a character which is essentially or heavily based on a stereotype. - Disallowing a character access to certain things due to their species, skin color, gender, or other factors. - Calling a character a slur, be it real world or fictionalized. - An example of a disallowed fictional slur would be "clanker."
